aspects.says: Exponential backoff doubles the delay each attempt and caps it, computing the doubling so a large attempt cannot overflow to a zero or negative delay.
The order decorators are applied in matters, so a factory method makes it explicit.
Cross-cutting concerns such as logging and synchronization are independent decorators around one interface, combined in any order instead of a deep class hierarchy.
Each decorator decides whether to catch, wrap or propagate an exception; a logging decorator records the failure and rethrows it.
Extending Thread spends the one superclass slot and ties a task to how it runs; implementing Runnable or Callable and submitting it to an executor composes the two.

aspects.says: A parent and a child that synchronize on different monitors nest their locks, which risks deadlock.
